base-b.about: rhp as it is, a second bundle (A/A control)

poscompat.about: posnoinherit, with --rhp-position inherited again inside slat types whose CSS reads it

noguard.about: the guard's 42 resets gone (box-sizing kept, so a clean page draws the same)

noprotect.about: every page-protection rule gone: guard, sizes, view-transition, [hidden], ::before/::after, ::selection

safetrim.about: trimguard keeping the inherit declarations on every element: only background on blocks that set their own, float/vertical-align off the body, and leanguard's shorthands
